library_header.collections.description: Library header control: opens the library's collections page. A count follows it after a middle dot once known (Collections · 12), so keep it to one short word.

library_header.recommended.description: Library header control: opens the library's recommended page (the server's hubs for the library). One short word.

library_header.sort_filter.description: The name of the Library header's sort control (it opens the one menu holding the type to show, the sort order and the filters). Not drawn: the control reads as the sort icon, the chosen criterion and a down chevron, so there is no width to fit.

library_header.filtered_of.description: Library header read-out shown only while a filter is on: how many titles match, of how many the library holds (312 of 1,284). Both numbers arrive already formatted for the language.

library_header.show.description: Heading of the first section of the Sort & Filter menu, over the list of what the library page shows (Films, Shows, Seasons, Episodes).
